competitiveTarget: Beat Coldwell Banker / Windermere city pages — live neighborhood-level market data no competitor surfaces, plus the in-boundary listing map and scrubbable price history.
note: Experience System Geo archetype v3.1, 2026-06-10. Rebuilt from HeroBlock+MarketSnapshot to FlyoverHero+LiveMarketBand+CommunityMapLedgerPane+PriceHistoryScrubber+PaymentSlider+InlineValuationHook. Neighborhoods and communities render as editorial index rows (no tile grid). SectionNav anchor rail on every section. useEngagementTracking on every section via experience modules. All JSON-LD (City/Dataset/FAQPage/Breadcrumb) retained.

requiredComponents.name: FlyoverHero
requiredComponents.section: hero — FlyoverHero in POSTER mode (videoSrc=null, photoSrc=city hero image). Live activeCount + medianPrice Amboqia overlay + pulsing live-dot. Count-up animation via useCountUp.

requiredComponents.name: LiveMarketBand
requiredComponents.section: market band — navy band overlapping hero by -mt-12. One giant living activeCount (Amboqia ~6rem count-up) + 3 quiet aux stats (median, days, supply) + market verdict pill + report link.

requiredComponents.name: SectionNav
requiredComponents.section: sticky anchor rail — appears on scroll past hero. Links: market, listings, price-history, neighborhoods (Bend only), communities, open-houses, faq.

requiredComponents.name: CommunityMapLedgerPane
requiredComponents.section: listings + map — split-scroll spine: ListingLedger (top 8 newest active) on left, NeighborhoodMap pinned right (desktop). Hover sync between ledger rows and map price pills.

requiredComponents.name: ListingLedger
requiredComponents.section: listings — 1 dominant featured listing + hairline ledger rows, Amboqia price, edge-bleed photo. Used inside CommunityMapLedgerPane.

requiredComponents.name: PriceHistoryScrubber
requiredComponents.section: price-history — scrubbable recharts AreaChart for city median sale price (completed months only, >= 4 months gate).

requiredComponents.name: PaymentSlider
requiredComponents.section: price-history — inline mortgage payment estimate around city median. Renders when medianListPrice is available.

requiredComponents.name: OpenHousesGrid
requiredComponents.section: open-houses — next 14 days in this city. Renders nothing when none scheduled.

requiredComponents.name: ArticleGrid
requiredComponents.section: guides — recent blog posts scoped to the city.

requiredComponents.name: ActivityFeed
requiredComponents.section: activity — live new / price-drop / pending / sold rows, city-scoped.

requiredComponents.name: FAQBlock
requiredComponents.section: faq — verified market Q&A + FAQPage JSON-LD. Renders when pulse data is available.

requiredComponents.name: InlineValuationHook
requiredComponents.section: valuation-hook — navy CTA band replacing generic CTABar. What is your {City} home worth?
